source_refs.notes: Use plan completeness, explicit gate opt-in, ledger-progress guard and read-back attestation verification. Do not enable upstream hooks.

source_refs.title: Scale Engine third-party skill domain policy

source_refs.title: Agent Skills specification and reference repository
source_refs.notes: 2026-09-13 re-review confirmed the current Agent Skills specification still requires SKILL.md with name/description metadata, parent-directory name alignment, optional support directories, and progressive disclosure. Keep method-only adoption; do not install reference implementations or replace existing ADK target rendering.

source_refs.title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026
source_refs.notes: Use ASI01-ASI10 as a security coverage taxonomy and map each category to local controls/evidence. Do not copy the guide text or claim OWASP certification.

source_refs.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows safe outputs
source_refs.notes: Use read-only agent, schema-backed output and separate permission-controlled executor architecture with operation caps and kill switch. Current safe-outputs may auto-inject conservative create-issue behavior when outputs are omitted, so local policies require explicit output boundaries. Do not import workflows or enable GitHub writes.

source_refs.title: Model Context Protocol Registry
source_refs.notes: Use namespace ownership, version, artifact digest, review and freshness as MCP dependency provenance fields. The registry validates namespace ownership for publishing, but a listing remains discovery metadata rather than trust certification or install approval.

source_refs.title: OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for generative AI systems
source_refs.notes: Use an optional version-pinned field mapping adapter for trace summaries. The active GenAI repository covers spans, metrics, events, MCP and provider conventions while its Schema URL remains unsettled; prompt, completion, tool arguments and tool results stay disabled by default.

source_refs.title: Agent Client Protocol
source_refs.notes: 2026-09-13 re-review found the current ACP release line has advanced to 1.7.0 while the v1 JSON-RPC schema remains active; authentication, elicitation, and session surfaces continue to evolve. Keep watch-only: ADK has no transport runtime requirement, dependency, binding, or compatibility claim.

source_refs.title: Agent2Agent Protocol 1.0
source_refs.notes: 2026-09-13 re-review confirmed the official A2A specification still lists 1.0.0 as the latest released version. Continue watching Agent Card, task/artifact interoperability, and conformance maturity; do not add discovery, auth, network, remote-agent, or runtime bindings without a concrete use case and separate security review.

source_refs.title: Model Context Protocol 2026-07-28 final release
source_refs.notes: The 2026-07-30 ENHANCE decision refreshed immutable final release metadata only and did not activate the protocol. A separate schema-valid owner decision on 2026-07-31 later activated only the 2026-07-28 protocol governance contract; runtime, Tasks, Apps and extensions remain disabled.

source_refs.title: OWASP Agentic Skills Top 10
source_refs.notes: Use AST01-AST10 as an evolving skill-layer crosswalk. Do not copy the proposed Universal Skill Format, claim OWASP certification or treat roadmap content as a stable standard.

source_refs.title: Agent Skills in the Wild empirical maintenance study
source_refs.notes: Use the stable-behavior versus target-local-binding maintenance distinction and require explicit use/effect/refresh evidence. Do not copy datasets or infer local usage counts.

source_refs.title: Visual Studio Code Agent Skills
source_refs.notes: Watch .agents/skills and related discovery behavior as future target evidence. Do not add a direct target or promote vendor-only context: fork into core without a real use case and runtime smoke.
